The Tigor is gone, and the Aeris takes its place. We walk you around Tata's new compact sedan, which borrows its face and dashboard from the Tiago and adds a longer feature list.
Up front, you get slimmer LED headlamps with eyebrow-style DRLs, a gloss-black grille and pixel-shaped LED fog lamps. Higher petrol trims ride on 15-inch dual-tone alloys, while the Smart, Pure and all CNG variants make do with 14-inch wheels. At the back, a red strip links the new LED tail-lamps.
